# authwise_certificates (Data Source)

A certificate and, when kit minted it, its private key. The trust anchor SAML connections verify signatures against, and the client certificate an endpoint presents for mTLS. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) Every certificate under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `certificate_pem` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String)
- `has_private_key` (Boolean)
- `key_id` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `not_after` (String)
- `not_before` (String)
- `origin` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `subject` (String)
- `use` (String)
